reapack.name: Phase Rotation (RX-style).lua
reapack.desc: Phase Rotation (RX-style): suggest, preview and render broadband phase rotation for selected items

version.author: dennech
version.changelog: 1.1.1: analysis in source mode uses the item's window, play rate and channel mode; Link honoured by the extension's adaptive mode; JSFX adaptive interpolation matches the extension; legacy take FX removed when the source engine takes over; fixes from an independent code review. 1.1.0: Suggest reproduces iZotope RX 10's values (L8 criterion, RX sign convention). New engine: with the reaper_phaserot extension the rotation is applied to the item's source (no files, no take FX, waveform updates immediately, plain project file). Adaptive mode with look-ahead interpolation matches RX's adaptive peaks. Take-FX engine kept as fallback.

reapack.name: reaper_phaserot
reapack.desc: Phase rotation source engine for the Phase Rotation (RX-style) script

version.author: dennech
version.changelog: 1.0.1: deferred deletion of replaced source wrappers (audio-thread safety), separate decoder for UI reads, no allocations in the audio path, Link for adaptive mode, take-window/channel-mode aware analysis, sources restored on unload.
